entities.summary: Karl Groos was a German philosopher and psychologist who proposed an evolutionary instrumentalist theory of play. His 1898 book on The Play of Animals suggested that play is a preparation for later life. Karl Groos was a writers & intellectuals from Heidelberg (1861-12-10, Heidelberg–1946-03-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
